description: This line plot illustrates the BLEU score as a function of Average Lagging (AL) for four different training consistency methods. The x-axis represents Average Lagging (AL) in linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 10.0, with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis represents BLEU score, also on a linear scale, ranging from 18 to 28, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot contains four distinct lines: the 'Consistency-CE' line is purple with circular markers and a dashed line style; the 'Inconsistency-CE' line is dark purple with square markers and a solid line style; the 'Inconsistency-CE-MP' line is blue with square markers and a dashed line style; and the 'Consistency-Bi' line is red with star markers and a solid line style. The 'Consistency-Bi' line starts at a BLEU score of approximately 22.0 when AL is 0.0 and increases to a peak of approximately 28.5 when AL is 7.5, then slightly decreases to approximately 28.2 at AL 10.0. The 'Inconsistency-CE-MP' line begins at approximately 18.0 at AL 0.0 and rises steadily to approximately 27.0 at AL 10.0. The 'Inconsistency-CE' line starts at approximately 20.0 at AL 0.0 and increases to approximately 27.0 at AL 10.0. The 'Consistency-CE' line begins at approximately 19.0 at AL 0.0 and rises to approximately 27.0 at AL 10.0.
